# AJ Fence Inc.

> AJ Fence Inc. is a family-owned fence company founded in 2004 and based in Lakeland, Florida. It designs and installs custom residential and commercial fences in Polk and Hillsborough counties.

AJ Fence installs vinyl, aluminum, wood, and chain-link fences for homeowners and businesses. Projects can address privacy, security, and property boundaries. Use the contact page to request a free estimate and confirm service availability for a specific address.

Business address: 3929 Old Tampa Hwy., Lakeland, FL 33811
Polk County phone: +1 (863) 816-3117
Hillsborough County phone: +1 (813) 239-4122
Email: ajfencemfg@gmail.com
